about: Pages made but not yet live on the website. Read by the Standby tab on admin/board.html. Keep in step with the Future pages and Idea pages tabs of the site pages hub. file = page on GitHub (previews inside the board); art = Claude artifact id (opens in a new tab).

pages.name: Which Airshow Suits You?
pages.status: Built, Wix page made but hidden
pages.goes: Planning Guides, guide 1 of 9 under Planning Your First Airshow
pages.note: Helps a first timer pick a show. The Wix page /first-airshow-which-show already loads it, so it only needs adding to the menu.

pages.name: Weather And Will It Fly?
pages.goes: Planning Guides, guide 3 of 9 under Planning Your First Airshow
pages.note: What happens to the flying when the cloud comes in, and why it is still worth going. Planning Your First Airshow already links to /first-airshow-weather.

pages.name: On The Day
pages.status: Built, Wix page made but hidden
pages.goes: Planning Guides, guide 5 of 9 under Planning Your First Airshow
pages.note: Arriving, saving your pitch, the static show, the flying and getting home.

pages.name: Safety And Show Rules
pages.status: Built, Wix page made but hidden
pages.goes: Planning Guides, guide 6 of 9 under Planning Your First Airshow
pages.note: Bag searches, the crowd line, marshals and show rules. Overlaps Security And Bag Searches, so it may want trimming.

pages.name: Nikon D500 3D Camera Guide
pages.status: On GitHub, Wix page still to make
pages.goes: Photography, a tile on the Airshow Photography Hub
pages.note: A 3D D500 you can turn round and tap, with what each control does on a show day, settings for jets, props, helicopters and static aircraft, and a ten step set up. Wix page /nikon-d500-guide still to be made.

pages.name: Show Day Live
pages.status: On GitHub, Wix page still to add
pages.goes: Planning Guides, and the Show Day tab in My Airshow Hub
pages.note: Running orders from the Flying Programmes collection, with member uploads checked before they go live. Needs its own Wix page and page code.

pages.name: Contact The Guide
pages.goes: Community, in place of the Contact Us page built in the Wix editor
pages.note: A designed contact page with three ways in: send a message, suggest a show and report a correction.

pages.name: Headcorn Airshow
pages.goes: Find Your Airshow, if Headcorn comes back as a featured show
pages.note: Taken out of the Find Your Airshow menu, the featured list, links and footer on 27 Oct. The page is kept so it can come back.

pages.name: Airshows On A Budget
pages.goes: Planning Guides, under Planning Your First Airshow
pages.note: Day cost planner with your own prices, the free seaside shows, saving on tickets, travel and food, and what is worth paying for.

pages.name: Partner And Member Hubs
pages.note: Seven hubs, each with a public page, a log in preview and a build list: Organiser Hub, Stay partners, Transport partners, Advertise with us, Supporters club, Contributor Hub, and Clubs and groups.

pages.name: Community Forum Guide
pages.goes: Community, as a help page for forum members
pages.note: Every part of the forum step by step, for members and for you as admin, shown on the real forum design with example members.

pages.name: How Joining Works
pages.goes: Community, as a short help page
pages.note: What a new member sees from first visit to first thread, shown with an example member called Alex.

pages.name: Airshow Passport
pages.goes: Every featured show page, with stamps that follow you from page to page
pages.note: Stamp each show you have been to, add the seasons you went, your best moment and favourite display.

pages.name: Will It Fly Today
pages.goes: Planning Guides, beside Weather And Will It Fly?
pages.note: Slide the cloud base and visibility to see a full, rolling or flat show, and which aircraft are still likely to display.

pages.name: Display Gap Finder
pages.goes: Planning Guides or Show Day Live
pages.note: Tick the displays you will not miss and it finds the quiet gaps for toilet, food and stall breaks.

pages.name: Build Your Kit Calculator
pages.note: Two lists, photography by camera brand and camping, adding up what a full kit costs new. Prices are examples.
